shortBio.id: Profesional di bidang operasional, procurement, dan business management dengan pengalaman dalam proyek infrastruktur, transportasi mineral, pengadaan barang, real estate, serta koordinasi lintas fungsi.
shortBio.en: Operations, procurement, and business management professional with hands-on leadership in large-scale infrastructure, mineral transport logistics, real estate operations, and cross-functional execution.

fullBio.id:
Profesional Operations, Procurement, dan Business Management dengan pengalaman dalam pengelolaan operasional proyek infrastruktur, transportasi mineral, pengadaan barang, serta pengembangan bisnis di sektor real estate. Memiliki kompetensi dalam operational management, procurement strategy, vendor management, logistics coordination, KPI monitoring, serta pengawasan operasional perusahaan secara menyeluruh.

Terbiasa bekerja secara lintas divisi dengan tim operasional, procurement, finance, engineering, dan stakeholder eksternal dalam lingkungan kerja yang dinamis dan berorientasi target. Memiliki kemampuan leadership, komunikasi strategis, serta pengambilan keputusan yang kuat melalui pengalaman memimpin organisasi tingkat universitas dan manajemen perusahaan.

Mampu mengelola aktivitas operasional, pengendalian performa bisnis, koordinasi proyek, serta memastikan pencapaian target perusahaan secara efektif, efisien, dan sesuai standar profesional.
fullBio.en:
Operations, Procurement, and Business Management professional with extensive background in executing infrastructure project logistics, mineral bulk hauling, material procurement pipelines, and commercial real estate development. Proven competence across operational governance, vendor negotiations, supply chain dispatching, KPI monitoring, and enterprise performance management.

Experienced in cross-functional collaboration alongside operations, procurement, finance, civil engineering, and external regulatory stakeholders within fast-paced, milestone-driven environments. Strong leadership pedigree, strategic institutional communication, and executive decision-making forged through university-wide presidency and corporate operations stewardship.

Adept at streamlining operational workflows, steering business performance, orchestrating complex projects, and driving target delivery effectively, efficiently, and in strict adherence to corporate compliance.

Memastikan implementasi SOP, administrasi operasional, dan compliance perusahaan berjalan dengan baik.
en: Direct enterprise operations across commercial procurement and real estate divisions to ensure business continuity and top-line target realization.
Supervise procurement cycles, vendor qualification, project delivery timelines, and daily commercial workflows according to corporate benchmarks.
Formulate operational optimization strategies and enterprise performance controls centered on cost reduction, service excellence, and business expansion.
Liaise with internal department heads and external partners for project execution, strategic commercial alliances, and corporate ventures.
Govern corporate KPI metrics, executive reporting decks, and operational performance audits to maximize cross-functional productivity.
Enforce institutional Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), operational governance, and regulatory compliance standards across all workflows.
